question: Why is a mantra in the susiddha relation considered already accomplished for the practitioner?
premises: In the susiddha case the mantra is already accomplished.
This accomplishment is due to effort made in a previous birth.
inference: Prior-birth practice explains the immediate efficacy of a susiddha mantra.
plain_english: But in the susiddha case it is indeed already accomplished, because of effort made in a previous birth.
